results.title: Cloud Backup and Data Restore
results.snippet:
All backup and restore for your daily important data backup, contacts backup, SMS messages, call logs, calendar and apps. Choose local backup or cloud backup and restore it quickly with just a few clicks.

Phone problems can happen after a factory reset, when you get a new phone, or while moving your data to another device. This free phone backup and restore app lets you save your important data and restore it anytime without using a computer.

What You Can Backup and Restore
Contacts - Save your contacts and restore them anytime.
Text Messages - Backup your SMS and MMS messages, then restore them whenever you need.
Call History - Save your call history and restore it after a factory reset or when you switch to a new phone.
Calendar - Backup your calendar events and restore them later so you don't lose important dates.
Apps - Save your app installation files (APK) and restore them later. You can also keep a copy of your APK files for future use.

Choose Where to Save Your Backup
Local Backup - Save your backup on your phone for quick and easy access.
Cloud Backup - Upload your backup to cloud storage to keep it safe and restore it whenever you need.
You can change where your backups are saved anytime in Settings.

Before you restore
Restore works only for backups created with this app; it can't recover previously deleted data.
This is data backup and restore, not live data transfer between phones.
Photos and videos aren't included - this tool focuses on contacts backup, SMS backup, call logs, calendar, and app backup and restore.

Secure and Private
Your data never goes to our servers. All backups stored on your device or personal Google Drive. We never collect, sell, or share your data. Complete privacy and security guaranteed.

Key Features:
SMS backup and restore
Contacts backup and restore
Call log backup and restore
Calendar backup and restore
APK and app backup and restore
Document and file backup
Google Drive cloud backup
Local storage backup
Phone clone and data transfer
One tap full phone backup
Data recovery and restore
Secure and private backup
New phone data transfer

Download Cloud Backup and Data Recovery - the best phone backup app, data transfer app, phone clone app, and data recovery app for Android. Never lose your data again!

⚠️ Disclaimer:
SMS restore requires the app to temporarily become the default SMS handler as mandated by Android OS. This role is only requested during SMS restore and not used for any other purpose. Your data is never transmitted to our servers.

results.title: pCloud: Cloud Storage
results.snippet:
pCloud is the secure place to store, preview and share files, anywhere you go. Start with up to 10 GB free storage.

You'll be able to backup photos and videos from your device, play your personal playlists, or preview work-related documents. You'll also be able to share large files with anyone and control access with password protection and expiration dates. From your vacation photos to videos and work documents, pCloud brings all your files together.

• Start with up to 10 GB free. Extend the space on your phone with up to 2 TB
• Choose where to store your files - in the United States or the European Union.
• Scan invoices, reports or receipts with an easy-to-use document scanner.
• Backup photos and videos from your phone with the option Automatic Upload.
• Access and preview files across all your devices.
• Share large files with added security (password protection, expiration date).
• Play your personal music collection with the built-in audio player.
• Get offline access to important files, when you're on the go.
• Encrypt private files with client-side encryption, using pCloud Encryption.

Use pCloud Encryption as the vault for your passwords, financial reports or other sensitive documents. The files you upload to the Crypto folder will be protected with client-side encryption. This means that they will be encrypted before they get uploaded to pCloud. With pCloud's zero-knowledge privacy policy we, as a service provider, will not know what kind of data you store in the Crypto folder.

pCloud is also available for iOS, desktop (Windows, macOS and Linux) and from my.pCloud.com.

results.title: SMS Backup & Restore
results.snippet:
SMS Backup & Restore is an app that backs up (creates a copy of) SMS & MMS messages and call logs currently available on the phone. It can also restore messages and call logs from already existing backups.

Note: This app requires existing backups to be able to restore call logs and messages. It cannot recover anything without existing backups.

To view the contents of the backups, visit https://www.synctech.com.au/view-backup/

For questions or issues please visit our FAQ at: https://synctech.com.au/sms-faqs/


APP FEATURES:
- Backup SMS (text) messages, MMS and call logs in XML format.
- Local device backup with options to automatically upload to Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive.
- Choose a recurring scheduled time to automatically backup.
- Option to select which conversations to backup or restore.
- View and drill into your local and cloud backups.
- Search backups.
- Restore/transfer backup to another phone. Backup format is independent of the Android version so the messages and logs can be easily transferred from one phone to another, irrespective of the version.
- Fast Transfer between 2 phones over WiFi direct
- Free up space on your phone. Delete all SMS messages or call logs on the Phone.
- Email a backup file.
- The XML backup can be viewed on a computer via the online viewer at https://SyncTech.com.au/view-backup/

Notes:
- Tested on Android 5.0 and higher
- App only restores backups made by this app
- Backup is created locally on the phone by default, but has options to upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or Email. At no time are the files sent to the developer.
- Please ensure there is a copy of the backup outside the phone before performing a factory reset on the phone.

This App needs access to the following:
* Your messages: Backup and Restore messages. Receive SMS permission needed to properly handle messages received while the app is the default messaging app.
* Your Calls and Contact information: Backup and Restore Call Logs.
* Storage: To create the Backup file on the SD card.
* Network view and communication: Allows the app to connect to wifi for backup
* Your social information: To display and store the contact names in the Backup file.
* Run at start-up: Start scheduled Backups.
* Prevent Phone from Sleeping: To prevent the phone from going to sleep/suspended state while a Backup or Restore operation is in progress.
* Test access to Protected Storage: To create the Backup file on the SD card.
* Account Information: To authenticate with Google Drive and Gmail for cloud uploads.
* Location: Only requested and used during WiFi direct transfer due to a security requirement on Android.

results.title: Swift Backup
results.snippet:
Keep the parts of your Android setup that matter.

Restore them when you switch phones, reset your device or need an earlier backup. Swift Backup gives you one place to manage local, cloud and self-hosted backups without locking you into a single storage provider.

What you can back up
• Apps and APKs
• App data and selected app settings on rooted devices
• Messages and call logs
• Folders and files
• Applied wallpapers
• Saved Wi-Fi networks with Root or Shizuku on supported Android versions

Store backups your way
Save backups on internal storage, an SD card or USB drive where supported.

Connect Swift Backup to:
• Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and Box
• Mega.nz, pCloud, Filen, Yandex.Disk and Cloud Mail.Ru
• WebDAV, including Nextcloud, ownCloud and compatible NAS devices
• S3-compatible storage
• SMB, SFTP, FTP, FTPS and FTPES servers

Designed for real backup workflows
• Create device and cloud backups
• Restore individual APKs manually without root
• Use Root or Shizuku for supported batch operations
• Keep multiple app backup versions, add notes and protect important backups
• Schedule recurring backups to device storage or a connected cloud account
• Group apps with labels and apply custom backup and restore configurations
• Use incremental folder backups to store changed files efficiently
• Search apps, share APKs and manage backups from one clear home screen

Root and Shizuku
Root is not required to back up APKs, messages, call logs, folders or wallpapers.

Backing up and restoring private app data requires root. Some protected app files and batch restore actions require Root or Shizuku, depending on your Android version. See the FAQ for exact requirements.

Premium features
• Cloud backups for apps and folders
• Scheduled backups
• Backup history, notes and protected backups
• App labels
• Custom app backup and restore configurations

Sign-in and encryption
You can use Swift Backup anonymously and offline for local backups. Google Sign-in is required for cloud backups and Premium features. Browser-based sign-in is available on devices without Google Play services.

Backups are encrypted, except APKs, expansion files and wallpapers. Backups are tied to the Swift Backup account used to create them, so use the same account when moving to another device.

Learn more
• FAQ: www.swiftapps.org/faq
• Common issues: www.swiftapps.org/issues
• Email: support@swiftapps.org
• Telegram: https://t.me/swiftbackupsupport

results.title: MobiDrive Cloud Storage & Sync

• Need a practical video storage or photo storage but the free 20 GB aren’t enough? Upgrade your drive to up to 2TB and enjoy sufficient storage to sync and backup.

INSTANT ACCESS TO YOUR FILES

• Ensure your photo storage and video storage are always up-to-date with the auto backup of photos and videos to the drive.

ENSURE YOUR FILES ARE ALWAYS SECURE
